rows.en:
Listen well, Kamen Rider BLACK! I will defeat you without fail and build the Gorgom Empire on this earth!

Be ready for it! Fuhahahahaha…

Nobuhikooo!

Nobuhiko… I'll never give up on you! I swear I'll rescue you from Gorgom and make you your old self again…
Drawing on the energy of the Heaven, Sea and Earth Stones, Shadow Moon has at last been revived, and has thrown down the gauntlet to Kotaro!
Can Kotaro bring back Nobuhiko's memories? Can he save the Earth… and the people he cares about… from Gorgom?
Fight on, Kamen Rider BLACK!
Hello, Amigo speaking…
Do you know someone named Shiro Kazami?
Eh… well, yeah, sort of… What about him?
He's in critical condition after a traffic accident…

A traffic accident?

…………

Hahaha… Hey, that trick's old news! This is a Destron trap, I bet! I know that game inside out.
Destron? What are you talking about?
If you don't like it, let me hear Shiro Kazami's own voice! Then maybe I'll believe you…
Oyassan, it's me!
That voice… Shiro!
I got careless… A Destron monster attacked me!
Where are you? Where?
Daiichi General Hospital.
Right, I'm on my way!
Defeat all Shocker and Gel-Shocker Combatants and the revived executive monsters!
Defeat all Shocker and Gel-Shocker Combatants, the revived executive monsters and the Gigant!
Defeat all Shocker and Gel-Shocker Combatants, the revived executive monsters, Swordsaint Birugenia and the Gigant!

Udesper Alpha, Udesper Beta…

You two are offshoots of Udesper, an honoured warrior of the Desper Army…

but I have given you abilities that surpass even Udesper's!

Your first mission is to strike down the hated [VAR6] and become my two trusted right hands!
To Fuhrer Geisel…
…we swear our loyalty!
Use Boiler Desper, and first learn what [VAR6] is capable of!
Udesper Beta… How do you intend to defeat [VAR6]?
First… we read the movement patterns of Goro Watari and Makoto Arai, and draw up a meticulous plan.
Bah! Too soft!
Udesper Alpha… Then let's hear your idea.
To beat him, we need a far more violent and destructive strategy!
Meaning what?
Missiles, man! Missiles!
What…?
We fire missiles into every place he might be hiding, one after another! Carpet bombing is the best method there is…

I see…

But… wasting the Desper Army's precious missiles just to hunt down one [VAR6] would be foolish!

What!? What do you mean, foolish?

Which method we use… we'll settle it with a duel between us! Come on!

Calm down, Udesper Alpha…

Whichever method we…

…!?

You! Who are you!?
Heh heh heh… Please, leave that task to us.
You're from that place called Naager, the battle fleet nation that's been backing the Neo-Human Empire, aren't you?
As expected of Staff Officer Udesper Alpha! You hear things quickly…
And what exactly can the likes of you do!?
Humble though our strength may be, we would very much like to lend you our aid…
Interesting… And how do you intend to go about it?

Heh heh heh… That, I'm afraid, is something you'll have to wait and see.

And now, Staff Officers Udesper Alpha and Beta… good day to you…
Hmph, "good day," he says!? Cheeky bunch!
Now, wait… A plan is best kept secret! Let's leave it to them for once.
What's going on!?
Sir… It appears someone has broken into the Radio Control Room!

What!? An intruder?

Impossible! There's no way an intruder could get into a base with security as tight as ours!

Furuhashi, Dan!
Captain! We'll head straight for the Radio Control Room…
Who the hell are you!?

Heh heh heh…

Well, well… It seems everyone's here. Pardon me for intruding…
So you're the intruder!?

I suppose I can't object to being called that…

True, I may be an uninvited guest, but…

I am an envoy from the battle fleet nation Naager. My name is Apfaron the Evil Scholar. And…

…!?

Anne!?
Likewise… I am Atefarina the Battle Princess.
You! What are you planning to do with Anne!?
I'm sorry to say… we've fitted a time bomb device onto this young lady's arm.
What!?
No, don't! Never mind me, take down the intruders!
Don't worry! We'll get that thing off you in no time…
Heh heh heh… That time bomb device won't come off without the Plus Ray.
The Plus Ray?
Damn it… What are you after? Why are you doing this?

Today… there's something we simply must let you all know.

And so… we came all the way here in person.
That time bomb device is, you might say, a little entertainment on the side…
Entertainment!?
Heh heh heh… Our mothership, the Space Fortress Naager, is already near Mars!

Your survey craft should confirm its presence soon enough…

Heh heh heh… I can just picture you all running around in a panic at the appearance of an unknown giant space fortress.
A space fortress…?

I get it!

You're the masterminds who've been backing every evil organization and working in their shadows, aren't you!?

My, my… It seems our Naager is better known than we thought.

But playtime is over! With this, our groundwork is complete!

From now on… we will carry out the plan exactly as our great Steel Emperor Zephas intends!

Be ready, you useless people of the TDF! Far beyond anything your power can reach, the Earth will sink into a planet filled with terror and chaos…
What!? Who are you calling useless!?
Steel Emperor Zephas!? Don't make me laugh!
I won't allow it! Such disrespect toward the Steel Emperor Zephas!

Wait! Atefarina… The time has not yet come!

Now then… It seems we've overstayed our welcome.

Everyone… I do think you'd be wise to tighten the TDF's security a little.

Not every invader will be as polite as we are, after all. And now, good day…
H-hold it!
They vanished…

…!?

So the mastermind has finally declared war on us…

U09656: narration-kind row is the continuation of Udesper Beta's speech, interrupted by Apfaron's arrival.
U09658: Udesper Beta asks this, but U09659 Atefarina replies to "Staff Officer Udesper Alpha"; translated as written.
U09665: [ja] read as "a plan is best kept secret".
U09670: narration-kind row continues Furuhashi's line from U09669 after a cut.
U09688: 探査締 read as 探査艇 "survey craft".
U09691/U09695: "TDF" appears in the Japanese (Ultraseven's Terrestrial Defense Force); kept as TDF.
